newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: AdvTech buys college for 6.1 million rand.
newsitem.headline: AdvTech buys college for 6.1 million rand.

text.p: Advanced Technical Systems Ltd said on Monday it had acquired the Global School of Business for 6.1 million rand.
Managing director Renney Plit said the purchase would translate into an increase in earnings per share of two to three cents.

"This will provide a further boost to the overall performance of the group, which is expected to show substantial growth in earnings in its interim report for the period ending on August 31, 1996," he added.
The purchase price is based on Global School of Business achieving pre-tax earnings of 900,000 rand in the year to December 31, 1996 and 1.4 million in 1997.
